questions: Are we allowed to move any number of stones from bag A to bag B, including zero stones, or must we move at least one stone per operation?
Can we move stones from bag A to bag B even if bag A becomes empty afterward, or must bag A retain at least one stone?
Is the operation allowed to move stones from bag B to bag A as well, or is the direction fixed as 'from A into B' meaning A is source and B is destination?
Do we consider the XOR of the final counts after any finite number of operations, or is there a limit on the number of operations?
Are the bags distinguishable for the purpose of counting different possible XOR values, or only the multiset of final stone counts matters?
Is the total number of stones conserved across operations, i.e., no stones are created or destroyed?
Can we choose the same bag for both A and B in an operation, effectively moving stones from a bag to itself?
Are negative numbers of stones allowed in any bag during or after operations?
